result.notes: Full Next.js 14 App Router dashboard scaffolded. Stack: Next.js + Tailwind + Framer Motion. Includes: animated canvas star field with nebula, glassmorphism GlowPanel primitive, live Claude CLI streaming terminal (SSE via /api/claude/stream), OpenClaw and Hermes agent cards with one-shot messaging, pod queue viewer polling /api/pods every 5s, scrollable activity feed, mission header with live clock. Run with: cd dashboard && npm install && npm run dev → http://localhost:3000
